$comment: EXP3 Phase 2 — the House Register (EXP3 § 4.4). The single machine-readable list of every House-Register raster/vector asset, each locked to its content hash so the house cannot drift. A House asset's bytes may change ONLY in the same commit that updates its row here, citing the governing amendment. Verified by `npm run verify:living-home-assets` (scripts/ci/verify-living-home-assets.ts). Life assets are deliberately NOT listed here — their nature is that what appears is decided by data at read time, not by their bytes (EXP3 § 4.4). Brand marks (apple/logo/favicon) are owned by THA_UI_ARCHITECTURE.md § 10 / the Adoption Register and are deliberately NOT re-owned here (one owner per asset).
